title: Price and monetize
summary: Recurring revenue made real: the subscription product created and tested, the pricing change modeled and rolled out without burning the base, the bad charge refunded behind an approval.

parts.title: Create a subscription product
parts.guidance: Translate the approved offer into the subscription product's price, currency, billing interval and customer-facing description. Use the product-creation workflow to test the resulting checkout and billing behavior before authorized activation. Link the configured product identifiers to the tested commercial terms so later price changes target the correct live offerings.

parts.title: Roll out a pricing change
parts.guidance: Model the proposed pricing change against the current product configuration, customer agreements and affected cohorts. Use the pricing workflow to evaluate migration, communications and billing outcomes before approval. Retain the rollout decision, tested configuration and exception handling, distinguishing customers who have accepted new terms from those who remain on an existing arrangement.

parts.title: Issue a refund
parts.guidance: Identify the specific charge, customer and reason for the proposed refund, then verify the amount and previous refund history. Follow the refund workflow to obtain the authorized decision and submit through the correct payment path. Record the processor result and customer communication separately, and reconcile the resulting adjustment to the invoice and books.
